title: Mike Saliba
intro: Mike Saliba (Libertarian Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Michigan's 10th Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
